title: AND-Awareness
tagline: SkyrimNet awareness of Advanced Nudity Detection's clothing and flashing states.
description:
-Clothing Coverage prompt: injects a Clothing Coverage section into the character information
SkyrimNet sends to the AI, right after the worn-equipment list. It covers revealing garments (sheer or
covers-nothing), what is visible right now and which garment is responsible, and an overall
clothing-quality note. Exposure always comes from A.N.D.'s own state; keywords never invent it. The
section isn't shown on the dashboard's character bio page; it can be seen in the prompt payloads in
SkyrimNet's logs.

-AND_Awareness SKSE plugin (no Papyrus): watches A.N.D.'s flash states on the player and nearby NPCs
and posts a short narration line (or event selectable in plugin settings) when a flash starts, so nearby characters can react. Also raises the
SN_ANDFlash mod event for other mods.

-Settings page in SkyrimNet (Settings > Plugins > AND_Awareness): reaction chance, global and
per-actor cooldowns, player/NPC/followers-only, NPC distance, per-flash-type toggles and editable
narration text. Changes apply within about 10 seconds.


Created with Claude Code, housecarl and a few other goodies

Requirements:
Advanced Nudity Detection v4.x
Clothing/Armor properly tagged with AND keywords
